title.en: Ogives and graphical location of median and mode
title.kn: ಓಜೀವ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ, ಬಹುಲಕದ ನಕ್ಷೆ ಮೂಲಕ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ

hook.en: One curve counts students from the bottom up, the other from the top down. Where they cross, exactly half the class is on each side. That point is the median.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ವಕ್ರ ಕೆಳಗಿನಿಂದ ಮೇಲಕ್ಕೆ, ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಮೇಲಿನಿಂದ ಕೆಳಕ್ಕೆ ಎಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅವು ಸಂಧಿಸುವಲ್ಲಿ ತರಗತಿಯ ಅರ್ಧ ಭಾಗ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ಬಿಂದುವೇ ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ.

body.en: A less-than ogive plots less-than cumulative frequencies against upper class boundaries, starting from (lowest boundary, 0); it rises. A more-than ogive plots more-than cumulative frequencies against lower class boundaries, ending at (highest boundary, 0); it falls. The points are joined by a smooth curve (or straight lines).
body.kn: ಕಡಿಮೆ-ಓಜೀವ್: ಕಡಿಮೆ-ಸಂಚಿತ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮೇಲ್ಗಡಿಗಳ ಎದುರು ಗುರುತಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ; ಅದು ಏರುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೆಚ್ಚು-ಓಜೀವ್: ಹೆಚ್ಚು-ಸಂಚಿತ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕೆಳಗಡಿಗಳ ಎದುರು; ಅದು ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Marks of 40 students. Less-than cumulative frequencies: 0, 4, 10, 20, 32, 40 at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50.
More-than cumulative frequencies: 40, 36, 30, 20, 8, 0 at the lower boundaries.
The curves cross at 30 marks and cumulative frequency 20, which is N over 2.
So the median is 30 marks: twenty students below, twenty above.

narration.en: On the board: Median from two ogives.

body.en: Median: draw both ogives; the x-coordinate of their point of intersection is the median (its y-coordinate is N/2). With one ogive, mark N/2 on the y-axis, go across to the curve and drop a perpendicular to the x-axis. Mode: in the histogram, join the top corners of the tallest (modal) rectangle crosswise to the corners of the neighbouring rectangles; drop a perpendicular from the crossing point to the x-axis.
body.kn: ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ: ಎರಡು ಓಜೀವ್‌ಗಳು ಸಂಧಿಸುವ ಬಿಂದುವಿನ x-ನಿರ್ದೇಶಾಂಕ. ಒಂದೇ ಓಜೀವ್ ಇದ್ದರೆ y-ಅಕ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ N/2 ಗುರುತಿಸಿ ವಕ್ರದಿಂದ ಲಂಬ ಇಳಿಸಿ. ಬಹುಲಕ: ಆಯತಚಿತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅತಿ ಎತ್ತರದ ಆಯತದ ಮೂಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅಡ್ಡವಾಗಿ ಸೇರಿಸಿ, ಸಂಧಿ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಿಂದ ಲಂಬ ಇಳಿಸಿ.

points.en: Median: x at the intersection of ogives
Or read at N/2 on one ogive
Mode: crossing lines in the modal rectangle

problem.en: Less-than cumulative frequencies of marks: below 10: 4, below 20: 10, below 30: 20, below 40: 32, below 50: 40. Estimate from the ogive how many students scored below 35.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Less-than cumulative frequencies of marks: below 10: 4, below 20: 10, below 30: 20, below 40: 32, below 50: 40. Estimate from the ogive how many students scored below 35.

problem.en: For the same data (0–10: 4, 10–20: 6, 20–30: 10, 30–40: 12, 40–50: 8), the modal class is 30–40. Where would the graphical mode lie?

steps.en: The tallest rectangle is 30–40 (f = 12), with neighbours 10 and 8.
The crossing lines meet nearer the side of the taller neighbour (20–30).
The perpendicular falls at about 33.3 marks, which matches 30 + (12 − 10)/(24 − 10 − 8) × 10 = 33.33.

body.en: Less-than ogive goes Up (plot at Upper boundaries); More-than ogive goes down (plot at lower boundaries).

narration.en: Ogive rule of thumb. Less-than ogive goes Up (plot at Upper boundaries); More-than ogive goes down (plot at lower boundaries).

points.en: Less-than ogive: cf against upper boundaries; it rises.
More-than ogive: cf against lower boundaries; it falls.
The ogives cross at the median, at height N/2.
The mode is located from the histogram.

homework.en: Draw both ogives for: 0–10: 5, 10–20: 10, 20–30: 15, 30–40: 12, 40–50: 8, and find the median.

narration.en: Recap. Less-than ogive: cf against upper boundaries; it rises. More-than ogive: cf against lower boundaries; it falls. The ogives cross at the median, at height N/2. The mode is located from the histogram.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಕಡಿಮೆ-ಓಜೀವ್: ಮೇಲ್ಗಡಿಗಳ ಎದುರು cf; ಏರುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೆಚ್ಚು-ಓಜೀವ್: ಕೆಳಗಡಿಗಳ ಎದುರು cf; ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಓಜೀವ್‌ಗಳು ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕದಲ್ಲಿ, N/2 ಎತ್ತರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಧಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಬಹುಲಕವನ್ನು ಆಯತಚಿತ್ರದಿಂದ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತೇವೆ.
